title: Serverware native enrollment public evidence v1
description: Unverified public originals for the explicit native enrollment receiver. The complete wire original must be canonical compact sorted UTF-8 JSON plus exactly one LF, at most 1048576 bytes. Runtime verification enforces those byte/canonicalization limits, strict decoded bounds, independently pinned assignment authority, exact packet signature and genuine Nitro role-3/role-5 evidence on the caller's actual retained TLS connection. Schema shape alone verifies none of those properties. A successful diagnostic still has okForAction=false: no packet-semantic approval, installation permission, durable one-use claim, signing route or production enrollment receipt follows.

assignmentBase64url.description: Exact signedNativeEnrollmentAssignment/v1 original including its final LF, 1..16384 decoded bytes. The receiver must independently authenticate the authorizer PEM and its exact pin; this original cannot supply its own trusted root. JSON Schema does not decode or authenticate the assignment.

packetBase64url.description: Exact unsigned packet original, 1..524288 decoded bytes. Runtime hashes these actual bytes for the independent assignment join and verifies the purpose-specific enrollment signature over them; it does not interpret them as approved commands or installation instructions.

ingressSessionEvidenceBase64url.description: Exact nativeIngressSessionEvidence/v2 original including its final LF, 1..98304 decoded bytes, with paired nativeIngressPublicEvidence/v2. Genuine role-3 quote, runtime-root inventory and issuer/client-chain verification use the actual retained TLS connection and independently supplied expectations. No v1 fallback or copied verification summary is allowed.

enrollmentSignatureBase64url.description: Canonical unpadded URL-safe base64 of the raw 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the fixed NUL-terminated serverware/native-enrollment-packet-signature/v1 domain, SHA256(exact assignment including LF), unsigned packet byte count as u64BE, and the exact packet bytes. No ed25519: prefix.

enrollmentPublicKeyBase64url.description: Canonical unpadded URL-safe base64 of the nonzero raw 32-byte enrollment Ed25519 public key, not SPKI or PEM. Runtime must authenticate this exact key through the original purpose-role-5 Nitro quote; presence in this envelope is not authority.

enrollmentQuoteBase64url.description: Original role-5 Nitro COSE evidence, 1..12288 decoded bytes. The receiver verifies the genuine original using independent Nitro roots, expected runtime/PCR scope and the same actual TLS challenge/exporter binding; role-4 response signing or a diagnostic DTO cannot substitute.
